patterns.description: An asset brought into the business as capital
golden_rule: Asset: Real - Debit what comes in
Capital: Personal - Credit the giver
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Asset on the debit side; Capital on the credit side
wording_variants: brought machinery worth Rs.X into the business
introduced furniture worth Rs.X as additional capital
brought furniture into the business as capital Rs.X

patterns.description: Additional capital brought in during the year
golden_rule: Cash/Bank: Real - Debit what comes in
Capital: Personal - Credit the giver
patterns.journal_structure: Cash/Bank A/c Dr ... / To Capital A/c ...
patterns.ledger_effect: Cash/Bank balance increases (Dr); Capital balance increases (Cr)
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Cash/Bank on the debit side; Capital on the credit side
wording_variants: brought into the business as capital

patterns.description: Cash withdrawn from the bank for office use (contra)
golden_rule: Cash: Real - Debit what comes in
Bank: Personal - Credit the giver
patterns.journal_structure: Cash A/c Dr ... / To Bank A/c ...
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Cash on the debit side; Bank on the credit side

patterns.description: Cash deposited into the bank (contra entry)
golden_rule: Bank: Personal - Debit the receiver
Cash: Real - Credit what goes out
patterns.journal_structure: Bank A/c Dr ... / To Cash A/c ...
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Bank on the debit side; Cash on the credit side

patterns.description: A cheque issued/paid to a party
golden_rule: <party>: Personal - Debit the receiver
Bank: Personal - Credit the giver
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Party on the debit side; Bank on the credit side
wording_variants: issued a cheque in favour of Amit

patterns.description: A cheque received from a party
golden_rule: Bank: Personal - Debit the receiver
<party>: Personal - Credit the giver
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Bank on the debit side; party on the credit side

patterns.description: A cash discount allowed to a customer (alone or as part of a settlement)
golden_rule: Discount Allowed: Nominal - Debit expenses/losses
<customer>: Personal - Credit the giver
patterns.journal_structure: Discount Allowed A/c Dr ... / To <customer> A/c ...
patterns.ledger_effect: Discount Allowed increases (Dr); customer balance decreases (Cr)
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Discount Allowed on the debit side; customer on the credit side
wording_variants: received from Mohan Rs.A, discount allowed Rs.B

patterns.description: A cash discount received from a supplier
golden_rule: <supplier>: Personal - Debit the receiver
Discount Received: Nominal - Credit incomes/gains
patterns.journal_structure: <supplier> A/c Dr ... / To Discount Received A/c ...
patterns.ledger_effect: Supplier balance decreases (Dr); Discount Received increases (Cr)
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Supplier on the debit side; Discount Received on the credit side
wording_variants: paid to Amit Rs.A, discount received Rs.B

patterns.description: Cash (or bank) withdrawn for personal/private use
golden_rule: Drawings: Personal - Debit the receiver (the proprietor)
Cash/Bank: Real - Credit what goes out
patterns.journal_structure: Drawings A/c Dr ... / To Cash/Bank A/c ...
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Drawings on the debit side; Cash/Bank on the credit side
wording_variants: cash withdrawn from bank for personal use

patterns.description: An expense paid in cash, by cheque or at once
golden_rule: Expense: Nominal - Debit expenses and losses
Cash/Bank: Real - Credit what goes out
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Expense on the debit side; Cash/Bank on the credit side
wording_variants: payment made for rent in cash

patterns.description: Goods taken by the proprietor for personal use
golden_rule: Drawings: Personal - Debit the receiver
Purchases: Nominal - Credit incomes/gains (goods returned to the business)
patterns.journal_structure: Drawings A/c Dr ... / To Purchases A/c ...
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Drawings on the debit side; Purchases on the credit side
wording_variants: withdrew goods worth Rs.X for personal use
goods taken by the proprietor for private use

patterns.description: Income received in cash or by cheque
golden_rule: Cash/Bank: Real - Debit what comes in
Income: Nominal - Credit incomes and gains
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Cash/Bank on the debit side; income on the credit side

patterns.description: A question with several independent transactions - split chronologically, journaled independently, aggregated into ONE ledger and ONE trial balance
patterns.golden_rule: Each entry follows its own pattern's golden rule
patterns.journal_structure: N independent journal entries in order
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Aggregate ledger balances; Dr == Cr
wording_variants: Started business ... . Purchased goods ... . Paid rent ... .
Sold goods to Mohan ... . Received from him ... discount allowed ...
Purchased goods ... . Paid him Rs.X immediately.
refusal_conditions: any segment missing an amount -> BLOCKED (no partial fabrication)
continuation pronouns resolve only to a previously named party

patterns.description: Cash/cheque paid TO a party (settling a creditor or any payment to a person)
golden_rule: <party>: Personal - Debit the receiver
Cash/Bank: Real - Credit what goes out
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Party on the debit side; Cash/Bank on the credit side
wording_variants: paid to Rahul Rs.X in cash
issued a cheque in favour of Amit

patterns.description: A fixed asset purchased for cash/cheque - EXACT named asset only
golden_rule: Asset: Real - Debit what comes in
Cash/Bank: Real - Credit what goes out
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Asset on the debit side; Cash/Bank on the credit side
wording_variants: building purchased for Rs.X in cash
purchased furniture costing Rs.X, payment made immediately

patterns.description: A fixed asset purchased on credit from a supplier
golden_rule: Asset: Real - Debit what comes in
<supplier>: Personal - Credit the giver
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Asset on the debit side; supplier on the credit side
wording_variants: bought furniture from Vijay on credit
purchased machinery from Suresh on credit
furniture purchased from Rahul for Rs.X on credit

patterns.description: Goods purchased for cash or by cheque
golden_rule: Purchases: Nominal - Debit expenses and losses
Cash/Bank: Real - Credit what goes out
patterns.journal_structure: Purchases A/c Dr ... / To Cash/Bank A/c ...
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Purchases on the debit side; Cash/Bank on the credit side
wording_variants: goods purchased for Rs.X in cash
goods purchased and payment made immediately
refusal_conditions: cash vs credit not stated -> REVIEW_REQUIRED

patterns.description: Goods purchased on credit from a named supplier
golden_rule: Purchases: Nominal - Debit expenses and losses
<supplier>: Personal - Credit the giver
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Purchases on the debit side; <supplier> on the credit side
wording_variants: purchased goods from Rahul on credit
bought goods on credit from Rahul
goods purchased from Rahul for Rs.X on credit
bought goods on account from Rahul
purchased goods worth Rs.X from Rahul

patterns.description: Goods returned to the supplier (returns outward)
golden_rule: <supplier>: Personal - Debit the receiver
Purchase Returns: Nominal - Credit incomes/gains
patterns.journal_structure: <supplier> A/c Dr ... / To Purchase Returns A/c
patterns.ledger_effect: Supplier balance decreases (Dr); Purchase Returns increases (Cr)
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Supplier on the debit side; Purchase Returns on the credit side
wording_variants: returned goods worth Rs.X to him
refusal_conditions: supplier not named -> REVIEW_REQUIRED (party inherited from the previous transaction when deterministic)

patterns.description: Cash/cheque received FROM a party (settling a debtor); also '<Party> paid ...' subject wording
golden_rule: Cash/Bank: Real - Debit what comes in
<party>: Personal - Credit the giver
patterns.ledger_effect: Cash/Bank increases (Dr); party debtor balance decreases (Cr)
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Cash/Bank on the debit side; party on the credit side
wording_variants: received from Mohan Rs.X in cash
received Rs.X from Amit in cash

patterns.description: Essential information (usually the amount) is missing - the transaction is NOT solved
patterns.trial_balance_effect: No trial-balance effect

patterns.description: The topic is outside the approved Ch.1-3 Unit-Test-1 boundary
patterns.trial_balance_effect: No trial-balance effect

patterns.description: The wording is ambiguous (cash vs credit, mode, discount context) - FT-E never guesses
patterns.trial_balance_effect: No trial-balance effect

patterns.description: Goods returned by the customer (returns inward)
golden_rule: Sales Returns: Nominal - Debit expenses/losses
<customer>: Personal - Credit the giver
patterns.journal_structure: Sales Returns A/c Dr ... / To <customer> A/c ...
patterns.ledger_effect: Sales Returns increases (Dr); customer balance decreases (Cr)
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Sales Returns on the debit side; customer on the credit side

patterns.description: An old fixed asset sold for cash/cheque
golden_rule: Cash/Bank: Real - Debit what comes in
Asset: Real - Credit what goes out
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Cash/Bank on the debit side; Asset on the credit side
wording_variants: sold machinery for Rs.X in cash

patterns.description: An old fixed asset sold on credit
golden_rule: <customer>: Personal - Debit the receiver
Asset: Real - Credit what goes out
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Customer on the debit side; Asset on the credit side
wording_variants: sold old furniture to Ramesh on credit
sold machinery on credit to Ramesh

patterns.description: Goods sold for cash or by cheque (a named customer never becomes a debtor)
golden_rule: Cash/Bank: Real - Debit what comes in
Sales: Nominal - Credit incomes and gains
patterns.journal_structure: Cash/Bank A/c Dr ... / To Sales A/c ...
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Cash/Bank on the debit side; Sales on the credit side
wording_variants: sold goods to Mohan for cash
goods sold and cash received immediately

patterns.description: Goods sold on credit to a named customer
golden_rule: <customer>: Personal - Debit the receiver
Sales: Nominal - Credit incomes and gains
patterns.trial_balance_effect: <customer> on the debit side; Sales on the credit side
wording_variants: sold goods to Mohan on credit
sold to Mohan for Rs.X on credit
goods sold on credit to Mohan
sold goods on account to Mohan

patterns.description: Starting the business with capital (cash, bank or named assets)
required_inputs: the capital side (cash | bank | named asset(s))
golden_rule: Cash/Bank/assets: Real - Debit what comes in
Capital: Personal - Credit the giver
patterns.journal_structure: Cash/Bank/<asset> A/c Dr ... / To Capital A/c ...
patterns.ledger_effect: Cash/Bank/asset balances increase (Dr); Capital balance increases (Cr)
patterns.trial_balance_effect: Cash/Bank/assets on the debit side; Capital on the credit side
wording_variants: began business with cash and furniture
started the business with cash Rs.X and bank balance Rs.Y
refusal_conditions: more than one named asset -> refused (never guessed split)
